item.title: Living the Brand
item.description: Gavin May was a young father already working in the trades when he found his way into the roofing industry. At 25, he was earning money working as a countertop programmer running CNC machines, but he just couldn’t see a future in it.

item.title: Remote Roofing
item.description: Imagine a roofing sales process executed successfully over the phone, available remotely anywhere, anytime. Griffin Libhart could see it and is part of the team implementing the revolutionary process at One Day Roofing.

item.title: Hands-on Experience and Digital Fluency
item.description: Being underestimated is Bradley Rathjen's competitive advantage. At 23, the estimator and project manager at Madsen Roofing & Waterproofing in Sacramento, Calif., has learned that when clients doubt you because of your age, there's only one response: become undeniable.

item.title: SPFA Convention 2026 Expands Education, Exams and Contractor Resources for Spray Foam Professionals
item.description: The SPFA convention in Las Vegas expands certification training, multilingual education tools, and networking opportunities while streamlining contractor access to exams, sessions, and expo resources. RC’s Jill Bloom speaks with the association’s Lisa Smith.

item.title: 84 Lumber Marks Women in Construction Week
item.description: 84 Lumber is spotlighting three employees during Women in Construction Week, highlighting career paths for women in building materials and construction leadership roles nationwide.

item.title: Celebrating Elevate's MAX PVC as IRE People's Choice Winner
item.description: PVC continues to be a fast-growing single-ply roofing category, driven in part by expansion in data centers, cold storage, and other mission-critical facilities.

item.title: PEPA Adds QXO, Launches Distributor Category
item.description: The Polymeric Exterior Products Association has added QXO as its first distributor member, launching a new membership category aimed at strengthening industry collaboration.

item.title: Duro-Last Appoints Greg Hudson Vice President of Commercial Excellence
item.description: Hudson will lead commercial strategy and market initiatives across all Duro-Last brands.

item.title: Enhancing the Experience
item.description: Victoria Ogrizek, 39, came to roofing through marketing and brand reputation, not through the trades. But that outside perspective became her advantage.

item.title: BITEC Celebrates 40th Anniversary in Roofing
item.description: Celebrating four decades of making modified bitumen the right way without sacrificing quality.
